function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH sales_cost AS (
  SELECT s.period, s.customer_id, s.sku, s.qty, s.revenue_cad,
         (pl.amount_cad / pl.qty) AS unit_cost_cad,
         s.qty * (pl.amount_cad / pl.qty) AS cost_cad
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
    ON s.sku = pl.sku AND s.period = pl.period
  WHERE s.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
),
channel_agg AS (
  SELECT sc.period, c.channel,
         SUM(sc.revenue_cad) AS revenue,
         SUM(sc.cost_cad) AS cost,
         SUM(sc.qty) AS qty,
         (SUM(sc.revenue_cad) - SUM(sc.cost_cad)) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.qty),0) AS margin_per_unit
  FROM sales_cost sc
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sc.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY sc.period, c.channel
)
SELECT 
  aug.channel,
  aug.margin_per_unit AS margin_per_unit_aug,
  aug.qty AS qty_aug,
  sep.qty AS qty_sep
FROM (
  SELECT channel, margin_per_unit, qty FROM channel_agg WHERE period = '2026-08'
) aug
JOIN (
  SELECT channel, qty FROM channel_agg WHERE period = '2026-09'
) sep ON aug.channel = sep.channel;","purpose":"Get channel-level August unit margin and quantities for both periods"}
